name: keep-warm
description: Keep Claude Code threads cheap to come back to

plugins.name: keep-warm
plugins.description: Type "warm" and the thread's prompt cache stays alive while you're away: one tiny ping after 50 idle minutes, off after 24 hours without a message. Shows the thread's size above the input box.

plugins.name: tokens
plugins.description: Type "tokens" for a one-line report of the thread's size and what it costs, without spending a turn.
